keepRecordingsWarning: Recordings hold the voices of everyone in the meeting. Tell the people you record, and follow the consent rules where you are: in many places recording others needs their permission. Recordings stay on this device, encrypted, and are not synced; they take about 2 MB for every 10 minutes of speech. They are deleted with their meeting, or all at once with Wipe all recordings. Only speech is kept, so silent stretches play as silence.
